known_limitations: Native Windows startup and Windows Job Object gates were not executed because no authorized Windows runner was available; this candidate does not establish Windows release readiness.
Native Linux startup was not executed because no authorized Linux runner was available; this candidate does not establish Linux release readiness.
Until the documented Windows and Linux commands pass against this exact release-candidate head, the candidate must not be described as cross-platform release-ready.
The r3 state schema is intentionally incompatible with pre-release r2 data; old data requires an offline migration or rebuild into a fresh r3 root and has no in-place compatibility path.
V1 remains a single-instance local-filesystem service with no multi-instance failover or online PostgreSQL migration path.
risks: Windows-specific process, path, signal, lock, and Job Object behavior and Linux-specific startup and shutdown behavior remain unverified until the external native runners report against head 1dc2e4c4982240dc9297ac12becc80bfe263e662.

The real Agent smoke is externally stochastic and authenticated: repeated USD 0.05 caps were rejected by Claude Code before the final USD 0.10 hard-cap run passed; operators must retain a bounded budget and treat external Agent availability as an operational dependency.

The approved pinned FastAPI, Starlette, and httpx combination emits one Starlette TestClient deprecation warning; it is retained without an unapproved dependency upgrade because all production and installed-distribution gates pass.

The real Logparse and generated Skill checks fail closed on checkout, configuration, Python launcher, or product-hash drift; deployment must preserve the pinned external checkout and validated launcher.
